test_crypten_model_against_torchvision: test a crypten model against its torchvision equivalent by comparing modules and parameters
test_check_modules_parity: test that a crypten model and torchvision model have matching module names and counts
test_check_parameters_parity: test that a crypten model and torchvision model have matching parameter sizes and pretrained weights
test_run_all_model_tests: test a list of torchvision model names against their crypten equivalents with pretrained variants
test_encrypt_and_verify_model: test that a crypten model maintains module and parameter parity after calling encrypt
